title: Editing shows Description and Part Number as ordinary text fields
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-FIELDS-01), with the description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Fields), is stocked at {Location-A} only.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Inventory and type {Part-A} in the search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Click at the end of the Part Number text and type X.
  4. Click at the end of the Description text and type X.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. Click the {Part-A} row again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: the first two fields are Description, holding {Description-A}, and Part Number, holding {Part-A}. Both are ordinary text boxes, with no edit button and no Confirm or Cancel buttons beside them.
  • Step 3: Part Number takes the typed X straight away and reads {Part-A} followed by X.
  • Step 4: Description takes the typed X straight away.
  • Step 5: the window closes without saving.
  • Step 6: the fields read {Description-A} and {Part-A} again.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S13-R11, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.1 (The part as it stands), 13 Oct copy.
